Treinamento de Samuel
Outubro de 2005- uma das HQs antigas do exército revolucionário, na Fronteira Sul, Penedoura, o local era um simples acampamento em uma mata de araucárias, os pinheiros elevados escondiam perfeitamente o acampamento revolucionário, embora tal discrição sequer fosse necessária naquele momento, oferecia ainda algum lugar tranquilo para não registrados, e treinamento principalmente.
Samuel, então uma mera criança de 12 anos, Manuela de então uma jovem de 21 anos, olhou para Samuel, acima de uma rocha vestido com roupas simples, regata azul com um lenço grafite ao redor de seu pescoço um shorts Tactel preto nas pernas, já Manuela era vestida com suas roupas típicas, a diferença era seu cabelo, pintado de um vermelho meio rosa, ela observava com um sorriso Samuel golpeando o ar, até que ele suspirou e falou;
"Tá bom quando eu vou parar de bater o ar e bater em alguém??"
Ele resmungou enquanto saia da pedra, e olhou para Manuela esperando ela responder.
"IYAAAH moleque, esse é o espírito, sempre focando na ação não? Lembra muito o Casdanão nisso!"
Ela deu uma piscadela e então recuou, tomando uma pose de luta, que mais parecia ela se preparando para dançar tango, Samuel sorriu com o desafio e e avançou, saltando é chutando, esquivando dos golpes de Manuela, onde ela fazia as mãos dela como lanças,, ela parecia mais se divertir do que lutar em si, ela bloqueou um dos chutes aéreos de Samuel com o antebraço e agarrou pelo braço,  rodopiando com ele, ate que Samuel achou uma brecha, agarrou aos braços de Manuela e...
[b]CHOMP[/b]!!
Seus dentes morderam os braços de Manuela sem dó, a pele deu espaço a pequenos furos que sangraram, ela arregalou os olhos um tanto incrédula e gritou.
"Aiiin!!"
Parecia mais um gesto dramático do que de dor real no entanto, ao se virar, planejando elogiar o garoto, viu Samuel já avançando para o próximo, Bardolomeo, que estava parado aí lado de Casdanel do outro lado do acampamento, ele sorriu e avançou:
"E aí grandalhão vem pra luta!"
Ele desafiou enquanto saltava para tentar pegar Bardolomeo desprevenido, mas o gigante se virou de lado, segurando uma bíblia em uma mão, e a outra livre, ele imediatamente deu um golpe com a palma da mão aberta, compactando o ar em um soco, que ele mesmo conteve, e apenas jogou Samuel contra uma pilha de caixas com algumas armas dentro, Samuel pareceu surpreso, e então sorriu com o desafio e procurou as mãos entre as rimas até pegar um cano metálico que iria ser descartado e colocou em suas mãos, ele andou a frente de Bardolomeo com uma expressão de desafio enquanto gritava sua arma improvisada, quando viu Bardolomeo avançar com uma agilidade surpreendente seu instinto foi bloquear o golpe com seu cano, em um momento de certo susto ele bloqueou, e sentiu como se o metal tivesse ficado mais rígido e forte, Manuela que observava de longe com certa admiração, comentou.
"Veja só como Samu(Samuel) já consegue manipular uma emoção passageira como um susto para que imbua isso em sua arma, claro, ainda é um tanto desleixado mas...."
Samuel empurrou sua arma contra Bardolomeo, e saltou esquivando de outro golpe com a palma da mão aberta, saltando sobre o gigante colosso e indo em direção de agora Casdanel, que estava de costas, ele esquivou sem nem que os olhos de Samuel pudessem ver, o manto de Casdanel tremulou contra o vento que começou a ficar mais frio e forte, Samuel não se mostrou afetado, pelo contrário, sorriu e avançou denovo com mais um golpe, errou novamente, Casdanel demonstrando a mesma agilidade, e assim foi, nunca conseguiu acertar Casdanel uma vez sequer, finalmente, enquanto saltava, Casdanel deu um golpe leve nas costas do garoto, para derrubar mas não incapacitar, ele sorriu ao lado de Bardolomeo, não um sorriso de desprezo, ou maníaco, mas até de certo...[i]orgulho[/i].

[Spoiler=Red July, Maroon August] 

The cyber attacks headed by the Thýven Republicans against the Tallislandic government proved effective in halting some government actions, though the attack also had many negative side effects.

In response to the Internet downings, the State of Rechia sent phonecalls to local police offices demanding state curfews for all citizens by 8 P.M, with orders to arrest anyone seen after hours. This proved effective in allowing law enforcement to end protests in Braanikov and Morawik, though this only enraged protestors in Tremilov.

As a result, the Tremilov protestors were able to push law enforcement out of the city entirely, planning to use the Rechia State Highway to link up and unite with Zelenovik. Following the seizure of Tremilov, the Governor of Rechia declared martial law mere days after the declaration of a curfew, deploying the Tallislandic national guard to restore control in all cities affected by the coalition's rise.

 

Jastrzeburg in the Eyjafjollum region was quickly seized by the coalition protestors, thanks mostly to the withdrawal of Government forces from the region to prevent equipment falling into the hands of the coalition. The seizure of Jastrzeburg however allowed for protestors in Dabrichau and Zielenstadt to unite into one unit. 

Following their unification, Kjersti Stennes made a public declaration online that the Anti-Principalist Coalition was the rightful government of Tallisland, that the government of Clifford Prisk was corrupt and had illegally skewed the earlier 2026 elections to prevent her Radicalist victory.

The Tallislandic government would usually be able to suppress these posts very quickly, but was unable to rally a significant resistance online as the post spread like wildfire and gathered support across the country. The words of Stennes emboldened resistance on the Grimsdalr Peninsula, with most government forces retreating to protect Hoscbus and Jaerlic.

Subsequently, Lukylod, Ofenhind, Miswig, Gliwig, Karwbridc, and Ironlorkston all fell to the Coalition, their police stations and armories raided and used to arm protestors. Rebel sentiment would only increase more as the Internet downing persisted.

When the Tallislandic government did eventually fix it's security issues, taking advice from Neue Republik advisors with prior knowledge on cybersecurity from the Nestor-Sikirsk conflict.

With all of this considered, Holy President Prisk followed the lead of Rechia and declared nationwide martial law. Where local law enforcement held control, citizens were to be corralled out of the streets into their homes, with those that refuse to be arrested.

To cities where the coalition had taken control, an ultimatum was issued on national television: Turn yourselves in within five days, or face the Tallislandic military.

Units were activated nationwide, rallying at Mirkówka, Byster, Jaerlic, Osliburne, and Evraibal, deploying all 100,000 active personnel across these locations, with 30,000 national guard scattered across the country. Holy President Prisk would also attempt to get into contact with the AWN, to which he was consistently unable to, worryingly.

Prisk was realizing far too late that the corporations were not on his side despite their silence, and like the greedy demons they are, they were merely waiting for their chance to show their true colors. After all, it takes a snake like Prisk to identify the other snakes around him.

In the meantime, Finley Gallagher continued his futile attempts at calling for the end of aggression, for both sides to lay down their weapons and negotiate an end.

Nobody ever listens to a centrist, however.

[/Spoiler]

[u][b]The Landing[/b] 
As the Tallislandic government reeled from the chaos, the 1st Carrier Strike Group of the United States of Oceanic entered the Tallislandic Straits under Admiral Fredrik Madsens command, bringing over 80 naval vessels and full air support from Carrier VSS Genkivea.

1st Carrier Strike Group fleet immediately established a 40 nautical-mile exclusion zone, warning all vessels that any approach without clearance would be considered hostile intent.

Within hours, USO Marines began amphibious operations at Evraibal Bay under a humanitarian pretext officially to secure peace and stability amid the communication blackout. The landing marked the first foreign deployment on Tallisland 

Simultaneously, USO Cyber Command launched Operation Blackthread, a counteroffensive targeting the Rebel New Network, believed to be the digital backbone of the Anti-Principalist Coalitions propaganda and coordination by cutting off connections.

Using advanced quantum intrusion suites, the USO dismantled over 60% of rebel communications within 48 hours, forcing them to rely on shortwave and analog channels. However, the offensive also unintentionally crippled several Tallislandic civilian systems, power grids, railway controls, and local news servers, further destabilizing public life. But USO ensures that aid will come with the support of USO supplies. 

Despite these setbacks, Madsen declared the intervention a strategic necessity to preserve continental order, aligning his actions with the broader Free Nations Treaty Organization doctrine. USO drones surveyed the coast, and rebel transmitters flickered offline one by one. It became clear that the rebels are a direct war threat.

[quote=skullsbrough;60629832]"Well, that's great. Im glad we seemingly have the same goals here, even if for different reasons. And yes, due to our...lack of a navy, we are mostly ground-oriented. I think there is something we could do that would greatly improve our strategic position in Tallisland in that regard."

He pulls out a map of the island chain in the white sea, which Tallisland owns.

"Fuelenger suggested to me earlier that securing these islands, almost dead center in the white sea, could be a good position to further aid Tallisland from, especially if we could secure intact airports so we could airlift troops and supplies more easily from those islands to the mainland. We would need your navy to secure the waters around the island. But according to Fuelenger, it wouldn't be hard to then secure the island through an amphibious landing"

He thinks for another second before continuing

"Speaking of navies, your navy is free to dock in Komend if needed for resupply in fuel and ammunition. If you airlift the munitions here beforehand, our dockworkers would be more than capable of loading them for you, which would be much faster than sailing all the way back to your country."[/quote]
